verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework with telephony support (carrier webhooks, SIP/PSTN transports), so human escalation via call transfer is a fair question for it. However, no evidence documents warm or blind transfer to a human, or passing context to a human agent. The multi-agent handoff evidence covers agent-to-agent specialists, and Flows functions that call external APIs are developer building blocks; neither counts as this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can escalate a live call to a human with warm or blind transfer, passing context along
